findings.summary: setActiveIndex was called as a side effect inside setOpen's functional updater, violating React's pure-updater contract. Harmless in practice (idempotent, absorbed by Object.is bail-out) but fragile and inconsistent with the pure updater in handleListKeyDown. RESOLUTION: fixed by the orchestrator — the click handler now reads `open` directly and calls the two setters separately. Re-verified: typecheck 0, lint 0, build 0, e2e 23/23.

Tab out of the open panel is unhandled, so the panel can stay open with focus already outside it (orphaned popup). Not required by FR-203.c and not covered by C3e, so not a contract violation. RESOLUTION: deferred by explicit user decision; recorded as a known limitation in docs/screens/SCR001_Login/spec.md §9 and in plan.md. Not silently dropped.

aria-controls references a dangling id while the panel is closed, because the listbox is conditionally rendered. Pre-existing; not introduced by this diff. RESOLUTION: deferred; documented in the screen spec known-limitations block.

IconFlagEn is a hand-drawn Union Jack with no MoMorph source node, unlike IconFlagVn. Honestly documented in the file's own comment but was not logged in clarifications.md. RESOLUTION: an asset-provenance note was added to docs/screens/SCR001_Login/spec.md §3.
